items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Big Syd' is made by the [INTERVIEWER], not the interviewee. The interviewee does not respond or provide any personal context regarding this individual.

ctx.x: -- Big Syd, when I asked him how much money did he want, he who was it for? said, it was (inaudible). I said, plus for Lena Horn. He said $500.00 a week.
